title: Access-denied state renders a keyboard-reachable request-access control
asA: a non-admin user routed to an admin URL
iWant: a clearly-labelled access-denied state naming why access was refused and a keyboard-reachable request-access control
soThat: I can request access without leaving the app or contacting an admin out of band

acceptanceCriteria.description: A non-admin principal reaching /admin renders a role="region" with an accessible name naming the denied action (WCAG 2.4.6), a paragraph explaining why access was refused (WCAG 3.3.4), and a request-access control (data-action="request-access") routed to POST /api/request-access. The control announces its state (idle, submitting, submitted) via a polite live region (WCAG 4.1.3).

When the request-access POST returns a non-2xx response or times out, the access-denied state announces the failure through the polite live region, the request-access control returns to an idle state (data-state=idle) and remains keyboard-reachable for a retry; no submitted-success announcement is emitted. Vendor citation on the WCAG live-region announcement path.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the access-denied state rendered and the applied notification blueprint returns a non-2xx or times out
acceptanceCriteria.when: the principal activates the request-access control
acceptanceCriteria.then: the live region announces a failure message, the control returns to data-state=idle with keyboard focus preserved and no data-state=submitted transition fires

acceptanceCriteria.description: The access-denied heading names the denied action, the explanation names the missing capability (principalDirectory when the console runs without any applied auth), and the request-access control exposes accName that matches the visible label per WCAG 2.5.3.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a principal without admin scope reaches /admin
acceptanceCriteria.then: the heading text names the action, the explanation text names the missing capability and the request-access control accessible name matches its visible label
